sources.snippet: Copy Models Large language model (LLMs) Tutorials 🐳 DeepSeek-OCR: How to Run & Fine-tune Guide on how to run and fine-tune DeepSeek-OCR locally. DeepSeek-OCR is a 3B-parameter vision model for OCR and document understanding. It uses context optical compression to convert 2D layouts into vision tokens, enabling efficient long-context processing.
